scientific_integrity: All finite-size equalities are proved analytically with explicit generator and stationarity hypotheses. Symbolic and rational computations provide independent algebraic checks, not proof of global literature novelty or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite N only, constant per-unordered-pair rate and complete graph, centered coordinates only; no absolute-position stationary law. Thermodynamic kurtosis ratios are moment limits, not distributional convergence. Novelty is qualified by potential implicit prior derivability.
source_ids: Boyd et al., Randomized Gossip Algorithms (2006)
title: Exact finite-size non-Gaussianity and gyration relaxation in cooperative Brownian resetting
